title: Neuro-Kurisu SUPER weighted engineering scorecard — WorkPass64
method: WorkPass64 closes a code-level archive/reconciliation lifecycle defect: unresolved outcomes cannot be evicted under hot-ledger capacity pressure; legacy archived unresolved entries remain visible and may receive only identity-preserving append-only authoritative reconciliation revisions. These implementation changes are not evidence of live provider/device transport or release readiness, so the official weighted roadmap stays at 80.1%.

workstreams.name: Canonical source lineage and single-owner architecture
workstreams.rationale: Single writable organism state/memory authorities preserved. WorkPass39 adds a read-only cognitive ownership map and typed flow validation without parallel runtime state.

workstreams.name: Runtime integration, API/UI routes and smoke/linkage coverage
workstreams.rationale: Any structured API approvalRequired challenge can now pause the actual originating call, show a redacted preview and resume its captured JSON request exactly once after explicit approval. The cross-surface queue is now read-only to avoid conflicting approvals. Dependency-installed Vite and browser E2E remain open. WorkPass62 adds an authenticated, read-only ActionGateway recovery endpoint and a visible redacted Runtime Atlas queue; installed Vite/browser E2E remains open.

workstreams.name: Memory 2.0, retrieval/admission and benchmark evidence
workstreams.rationale: Memory admission now respects net utility, harm/redundancy and provenance even without budget pressure. Independent labelled temporal holdout remains open and retrieval uplift is still zero.

workstreams.name: Agency, action schema, execution, outcome and reafference
workstreams.rationale: WorkPass57 hardens outcome truth and delayed evidence correlation: external postcondition mismatch is distinct from success; inferred durable idempotency protects legacy mutation registrations; late observations survive bounded-index eviction/migration; learning credit now requires source provenance and independence. Simulated integrations pass; real provider/device postconditions and reconnect/replay remain open. WorkPass58 adds preflight across the complete reusable-skill candidate set and project tool path before partial execution/budget spend; real adapter E2E remains open. WorkPass59 closes the false-outcome/false-learning gap: non-execution gates are audit-only, skill/project competence updates require actual executor entry, and partial replay plus a blocked step is not treated as full replay. Real adapter postconditions and restart reconciliation remain open. WorkPass60 added versioned project-step checkpointing and reconciliation-first resume. WorkPass61 closes the code-level authoritative provider-found receipt conflict using append-only evidence revisions: base execution/outcome fingerprint and original action/outcome/evidence event IDs remain immutable; receipt replay is idempotent, changed content conflicts, and revision refs persist through snapshots/migration. Real provider/device postconditions, actual process restart and live receipt semantics remain unverified. WorkPass62 forces process death after a simulated provider accepts the action and again after finalization but before receipt commit; read-only reconciliation and idempotent recovery keep the simulated side-effect count at one. Physical adapter E2E remains open. WorkPass63: ambiguous keyed mutator exceptions and negative responses stay pending, and reusable skill fallback/learning is suppressed; local filesystem read-after-write is proven, but live provider/device postconditions remain open, so score is unchanged.

workstreams.name: Portable subject continuity and social/known-entity dossier
workstreams.rationale: Unified cycle verification is tied to actual same-tick causal edges; this improves continuity evidence but is not a claim of subjective consciousness.

workstreams.name: External transport, SDK, idempotency and replay
workstreams.rationale: Stable IDs for new evidence and legacy ID continuity are improved; external transport delivery receipts/reconnect and multi-provider reconciliation remain open. WorkPass58 stops external HTTP callers from self-asserting autonomous provenance and keeps normalized decision identity across approval/resume; live transport validation remains open. WorkPass60 resumes unresolved work through read-only provider reconciliation and retains the exact operation identity while blocking changed payloads. Real provider receipt finalization and multi-provider transport validation remain open. WorkPass61 maps authoritative provider-found outcomes to a separate persisted evidence-revision record and CognitiveEventFabric reconciliation event without replaying the side effect or rewriting the original receipt trace. Real multi-provider delivery, live receipts and device transport recovery remain open. WorkPass62 adds a redacted unresolved execution inventory and exercises two SIGKILL/restart windows over the durable file store; live multi-provider/device delivery remains open. WorkPass63: lost-ACK/restart/receipt/read-after-write is now tested against a real local filesystem target with the provider receipt stored separately; live provider/device semantics still remain open, so score is unchanged.

workstreams.name: Research promotion and controlled experiments
workstreams.rationale: WorkPass40 reviews the existing source archives and upstream contracts, adds SBOM/provenance inventory, and adapts the documented OpenAI-compatible llama.cpp endpoint into the existing P40 model ecology. External source clones and target-hardware inference remain pending where network or target hardware is unavailable.

workstreams.name: Release durability: build, E2E, rollback, soak, SBOM/provenance
workstreams.rationale: WorkPass57 aligns root/runtime pass metadata, expands architecture audit to cross-package source imports, and passes source hygiene, integrity, syntax, receipt and recovery checks. Installed Vite/browser E2E, live provider/device validation, clean-room rollback, manual nested-source license sign-off and soak remain open. WorkPass58 aligns root/runtime release metadata and current-pass docs; root metadata contract and final packaged archive are revalidated before delivery, while actual release gates remain open. WorkPass60 adds scoped restart/reconciliation regression tests and release metadata, but production browser/device validation, clean-room rollback and soak are still open. WorkPass61 regenerates runtime release/architecture/archive manifests and synchronizes the current scorecard; this does not close production build, browser/device E2E, rollback or soak gates. WorkPass62 adds a child-process crash/restart integration with durable FileStateStore and visible recovery queue. App dependencies are not installed in this environment, so production Vite/browser/Live2D E2E, rollback and soak remain open. WorkPass63 adds the local filesystem failure-path E2E and release metadata contract; npm registry DNS prevented app dependency installation, so production app build/browser E2E, remote provider/device, rollback, license review and soak remain open.
